messages:
sara: heads-up — onboarding new org 'orca-ml' across AWS/GCP/Azure. Need a quick cross-cloud checklist for GPU quota + networking limits before we hand to infra. target: 40 A100-equivalent GPUs initially across regions. any gotchas?

alex: short checklist i use: 1) billing account linked + payment method verified 2) request GPU quotas per region (A100/V100 families) 3) increase ENI/EIP limits (aws) / external ips (gcp) / public IP limit (azure) 4) service-account roles + org policies 5) subnet sizes for node pools 6) tags and billing tags set 7) monitoring and SLO alerts 8) fallback regions defined (for capacity)

alex: for AWS specifically: request both 'p4' and 'p3' family quotas if you want flexibility. open a Service Quotas request + Support case. add this note: 'reserved for redwood-inference production workloads — contact eng-infra for verification'.

alex: sample AWS quota request text i paste:```We require quota increase for GPU instances in us-east-1: +20 g4dn.12xlarge (A100-equivalent) and +10 p4d.24xlarge for workload X. This is for production inference; we can provide architecture and expected qps. Contact: alex@redwood.com.```

tanvi: note on regions — us-west-2 has sporadic p4 stock right now. recommend primary us-east-1 and fallback to eu-west-1 for EU customers. also watch account-level soft-limits like ENIs and EBS throughput. ask for ENI limit bump to 500 and EBS gp3 throughput to match node counts.

jordan: GCP steps: request GPUs via compute quota page + open gcp support case for CPU+GPU combined quota. need to enable the 'GPUs' quota in each zone you want. sample gcloud snippet to check current quotas:```gcloud compute regions describe us-central1 --project=orca-ml-project```

jordan: for Azure: request GPU vCPU family quotas via 'Help + support' -> new support request. make sure subscription is linked to billing and quota type 'Virtual Machines (cores) - Standard_ND/NC families'.

mike: tagging rules — we need at least the following tags on resources: team=orca, env=prod, cost-center=ml-platform, project=orca-ml. please create a policy that blocks resources without tags in prod org.

sara: also: VPC peering or Private Link plan? we'll need cross-account access to model registry in central infra. prefer VPC peering in AWS and Private Service Connect for GCP.

alex: I'll open the support tickets. i'll include a capacity ramp plan: week1=10 GPUs, week2=25, week3=40. will ask for soft-reservations if available.

engops-bot: ticket ENGEXT-4827 created: AWS quota request (us-east-1 A100 families). assignee: alex. ETA vendor response: 72h. :spiral_calendar: 

tanvi: small ops note — if vendor approves region quota but stock isn't there, we need autoscaling + fallback policy in infra config. add a routing policy in cluster bootstrap: prefer region-us-east-1, failover eu-west-1.

sara: thanks all. alex can you post the ticket links and exact request payloads here when created? i will run through the IAM and tagging checklist tomorrow. :thumbsup:

alex: will do — posting links in thread once done.
